description: Historical source-access ledgers for this partition were absent. Current available review/source_checks do not reconstruct aliases, origins or prior access history; AP and The New Arab source holds remain recorded as pending. Do not interpret unsearched outlets or no-match as clearance.

Regional coverage is uneven: searches and captured sources were concentrated on Baghdad, Basra, Nasiriyah/Dhi Qar and Diyala. No systematic local-source sweep was completed for other provinces or Kurdish-language outlets.
The official MM baseline and source coverage equivalent to LexisNexis major newspapers remain pending; this month's findings are non-exhaustive.

For Oct18–20 Dhi Qar, reports conflict on security violence; a rights report alleges live ammunition while local reporting does not establish its use. The body evidence and contradictions are retained, not resolved.

The Tishreen anniversary/activist and employment protest candidates have unresolved turnout, episode links, exact venues or state-target details. No totals or cross-city event aggregation are inferred.
